title: Watch Target Routed Event
description: The watch sink acted on one detection: it filed or updated a ticket, only notified, skipped a duplicate, or failed. One routed fact per detection and action; the event id is uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, detection_event_id + ':' + action), so a republish of the same outcome carries the same id. The id alone does not make a detection single-outcome: a redelivered detection can yield a different action (skipped_duplicate after ticket_created) and so a different id, which is why the sink records the first outcome per detection in its own state and publishes at most one routed event for it. causationid is the detection event's id (the envelope validator enforces it). ordering_key is watch:<watch_id>, the same bucket as the detection, so an outcome orders after the detection it answers. A ticket reference here is the sink's own record of what it did; the board's own repo.task.* facts remain the authority on the ticket.

ordering_key.description: Section 11.1 bucket 'watch:<watch_id>', the same value as 'watch:' + data.watch_id (enforced by the envelope validator).

watch_id.description: The target's id; the same value as on the detection.

detection_event_id.description: CloudEvents id of the bloodbank.watch.target.detected event this outcome answers.

action.description: What the sink did: ticket_created (a new ticket), ticket_commented (the message was added to the open ticket of the same conversation), notified_only (the target's sink files no tickets), awaiting_button (the target files a ticket only when the operator taps Create Ticket on the ntfy push: nothing is filed yet and ticket_ref stays null; the tap files it later, and that outcome is not a routed event), skipped_duplicate (this detection was already routed), failed (the sink could not tell whether it acted; it notified instead of retrying a create).

ticket_ref.description: Board reference of the ticket created or commented on (for example ABC-123); null for the other actions.

notify_channels.description: Channels the operator was notified on, as '<kind>:<id>' (for example telegram:<chat id>); empty when none were sent.

reason.description: Why, for skipped_duplicate and failed; null otherwise. Never carries message text or credentials.

routed_at.description: When the sink finished acting, RFC 3339.
